scope: Same saved one-step holdings, frozen mu_H5, daily covariance and B. No new return paths; no realized returns used. Cost-zero solve is gross-objective diagnosis only.
fee_accounting: True sum of absolute risky traded NAV fractions, cash-funded. Net expected wealth=(1-fee)*(1+w_risky dot mu_H5).
break_even_scope: Algebraically extrapolate the same mu_H5 linearly with h/5, hold both compared targets and their upfront fees fixed, ignore all future trades and changes in risk/moments. Not a forecast, not an optimized horizon, not evidence of long-run superiority.
